plan.title: Fix TreeDataProvider getParent method for find task reveal
plan.overview: Implement getParent() method in the tasks-view TreeDataProvider to enable VSCode's TreeView.reveal() API. The method will use parent tracking Maps to return cached parent references for TaskItem, ActionItem, and FileItem nodes. StatusGroupItem returns undefined (root level). This follows the existing caching pattern already used for StatusGroupItems and TaskItems.

approach.rationale:
VSCode's TreeView.reveal() requires getParent() to traverse the tree hierarchy and find the element to reveal. The existing codebase already caches StatusGroupItem (cachedStatusGroups array at line 263) and TaskItem (cachedTaskItems Map at line 264).
The solution extends this pattern by adding parent tracking Maps: - taskToStatusGroup: Map TaskItem -> StatusGroupItem (for FR3) - childToTask: Map ActionItem|FileItem -> TaskItem (for FR4)
These Maps are populated when getChildren() creates the items, ensuring getParent() returns the exact same object references that getChildren() returned (FR5). Maps are cleared on refresh alongside existing caches.
This is a capability-only change (mechanism, no policy) that follows the existing factory-di pattern.

task.name: Verify Find Task reveal works
task.action: 1. Build and run extension: pnpm run dev 2. Open a workspace with .kanban/ folder containing tasks 3. Use Find Task command (Ctrl+Shift+P -> "Kanban: Find Task") 4. Search for and select a task from the quick pick 5. Verify task is revealed and highlighted in the tree view 6. Verify no error is thrown in Developer Tools console 7. Test with tasks in different columns to ensure all StatusGroupItems work
task.verify: Manual: Find Task reveals selected task without errors
task.done: Find Task feature works end-to-end without getParent errors

testing.automated: None required - this is a mechanism fix in a capability with no new business logic. The fix enables VSCode's built-in reveal() API to work correctly.
testing.manual: - Use Find Task command and select a task - Verify task is revealed in TreeView - Verify no console errors - Test with tasks in multiple columns (backlog, in-progress, done)
testing.regression: - Verify TreeView still displays correctly after refresh - Verify expanding/collapsing columns still works - Verify clicking ActionItems still runs commands - Verify clicking FileItems still opens files

edge-cases.case: findTaskItem() populates cache before getParent lookup, so parent will be available

case.scenario: Tree refreshed between find and reveal

edge-cases.case: Cache cleared, but reveal() will trigger getChildren() which repopulates cache before getParent() is called
StatusGroupItem returns undefined, which is correct for root items

pitfalls.pitfall: Using Maps keyed by task.id (for TaskItem) and by object reference (for ActionItem/FileItem) ensures same instances returned
Both parent tracking Maps cleared in createRefreshCallback() alongside existing caches
